messages:
morgan: heads-up — noticed a regression in SDKs v3.1 during canary: routing header format changed and Dedicated requests are falling back to default model variant a lot more.

samir: repro? can you paste the failing request/response?

morgan: sending minimal repro below. curl from a service that pins model via routing header.

morgan: ```
curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY\" \\n  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \\n  -H \"x-rw-routing: {\"policy\":\"pin\",\"variant\":\"v2-small\"}\" \\n  https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```

morgan: expected variant v2-small, but responses served from v2-default (latency profile).

jia: hmm — in 3.1 we normalized the routing header to snake_case internally then serialized it as JSON string. older clients used flat header fields, e.g. `x-rw-region: us-west-2` + `x-rw-policy: pin`. if services send the new compact json-string header and the platform expects separate headers, we can drop through.

leo: oof. did we not add a compatibility shim? I thought we had a parser that accepted both.

natalie: console team here — if this is true it's going to hit a bunch of self-serve users during canary rollouts. we should surface a migration helper in the Rollouts UX that detects header variance and offers to rewrite requests.

samir: quick workaround for services: set `rw_sdk_routing_compat=true` env in the SDK to emit both header shapes for a few weeks. I'll push a patch.

morgan: can we also get telemetry to count routing-mismatch occurrences? seeing a ~8% mismatch rate in canary traces.

ops-bot: incident-notify: new alert triggered — routing-mismatch-rate > 5% for canary pool (pool-id: dedicated-canary-7)

jia: i'll add a metric `sdk.routing.header.shape` with values `compact|flat|both|missing` and roll that to telemetry. should help quantify impact per customer.

leo: about quotas — i'm worried that rewriting headers on the platform side could change shard selection and double-count quota against different quota buckets. need to ensure quota routing is stable before auto-rewrite.

natalie: good catch. rollout UX should warn: "auto-rewrite may affect quota routing — review quota buckets before enabling." we can default to dry-run mode that logs the would-be rewrite.

samir: patch ready: emits both header variants + a prominent deprecation log for SDK v3.1. will push to canary. example: `x-rw-routing: {\"policy\":\"pin\",\"variant\":\"v2-small\"}` and also `x-rw-policy: pin` + `x-rw-variant: v2-small`.

morgan: thanks — rolling the patched client now. please also surface per-org telemetry in Console so sales/support can see affected customers.

natalie: working on a Console PR — add a "Routing header compatibility" card under Deployments > Rollouts that shows mismatch rate, sample requests, and a one-click "emit compatibility headers" toggle that triggers a managed rewrite in the gateway (dry-run first).

leo: gating item: gating rewrite until quota shard tests pass. i'll write the test matrix (shard keys vs header shapes). assign to me.

samir: assigning to @leo. i'll hold the SDK rollout until we have the dry-run in place (and the metric).

morgan: action list: 1) SDK patch (samir) — emits both headers + deprecation warning (in progress). 2) Telemetry metric (jia) — add `sdk.routing.header.shape` (in progress). 3) Console card + dry-run rewrite (natalie) — PR in progress. 4) Quota/shard test matrix (leo) — blocking. 5) Monitoring alert (ops-bot) — keep on for now.

deploy-bot: deploy started: devex/sdks/samird-patch -> canary (build 20260318.1) :rocket:

morgan: thanks everyone. please ping this thread when the console dry-run is ready so I can re-run canary traffic. :thumbsup:
